📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text into the box.
  2. See every repeated word ranked by frequency, with counts and share of total words.
  3. Accidental double-words ("the the", "and and") are flagged separately at the top.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as a repeat?

Any word appearing 2 or more times (case-insensitive). Common stop-words like "the" and "and" are included — the table helps you spot surprising overuse.

What are double-words?

The same word typed twice in a row, e.g. "the the". These are almost always typos, so they are flagged separately.

Does it ignore case?

Yes — "The" and "the" count as the same word in the frequency table.
